body:
Ported squish/gematria pipeline from the already-verified Go reference (gpt2-alpine-c/pkg/towerprint). fingerprint-az/za use I32 (overflows for long words, honest vs Go's bignum). Found new compiler gap (string/length via let binds void* not I32), worked around. self-test pinned against towerprint_test.go's real SALLY vector -- exact match. make test-mag-gematria green. PARENA commit ce4bfa7.

⚓ ☃
title: stdlib/mag/gematria.prn -- PARENA playground port of the mag book
